image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a large pipe organ. The image features multiple vertical metal pipes of varying heights and diameters, arranged in symmetrical groups within ornate wooden casework. The wood appears to be stained reddish-brown with decorative moldings. In the lower right foreground, a portion of the console is visible, showing stop tablets/knobs with labels. The lighting is somewhat dim, highlighting the metallic sheen of the pipes against the darker wood.
